subcategory_text: The criteria for initiating incident recovery are applied
implementation_examples: Apply incident recovery criteria to known and assumed characteristics of the incident to determine whether incident recovery processes should be initiated
Take the possible operational disruption of incident recovery activities into account
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the criteria for initiating incident recovery are applied.

Determine whether activities are conducted to apply incident recovery criteria to known and assumed characteristics of the incident to determine whether incident recovery processes should be initiated.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that take the possible operational disruption of incident recovery activities into account.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
